cards.back:
A set of keys that you press to type.
Bahasa Indonesia: papan ketik
Example: I type my homework on the keyboard.
cards.say: keyboard. A set of keys that you press to type. I type my homework on the keyboard.

cards.back:
The flat part of a computer or phone that shows pictures.
Bahasa Indonesia: layar
Example: The screen is bright and clear.
cards.say: screen. The flat part of a computer or phone that shows pictures. The screen is bright and clear.

cards.back:
A small tool you move to control a computer.
Bahasa Indonesia: tetikus
Example: Click the mouse to open the file.
cards.say: mouse. A small tool you move to control a computer. Click the mouse to open the file.

cards.back:
A group of pages on the internet.
Bahasa Indonesia: situs web
Example: The school website shows our timetable.
cards.say: website. A group of pages on the internet. The school website shows our timetable.

cards.back:
The worldwide network that connects computers.
Bahasa Indonesia: internet
Example: We use the internet to find information.
cards.say: internet. The worldwide network that connects computers. We use the internet to find information.

cards.back:
A secret word that lets you log in.
Bahasa Indonesia: kata sandi
Example: Never share your password with anyone.
cards.say: password. A secret word that lets you log in. Never share your password with anyone.

cards.back:
To copy a file from the internet to your device.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengunduh
Example: I will download the game to my tablet.
cards.say: download. To copy a file from the internet to your device. I will download the game to my tablet.

cards.back:
To send a file from your device to the internet.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengunggah
Example: She will upload her photos to the class page.
cards.say: upload. To send a file from your device to the internet. She will upload her photos to the class page.

cards.back:
A message sent over the internet.
Bahasa Indonesia: surel, email
Example: I sent an email to my teacher.
cards.say: email. A message sent over the internet. I sent an email to my teacher.

cards.back:
A small computer program on a phone or tablet.
Bahasa Indonesia: aplikasi
Example: This app helps me learn new words.
cards.say: app. A small computer program on a phone or tablet. This app helps me learn new words.

cards.back:
The programs that tell a computer what to do.
Bahasa Indonesia: perangkat lunak
Example: The software helps us draw pictures on screen.
cards.say: software. The programs that tell a computer what to do. The software helps us draw pictures on screen.

cards.back:
The instructions that you write for a computer.
Bahasa Indonesia: kode program
Example: We wrote code to make the robot move.
cards.say: code. The instructions that you write for a computer. We wrote code to make the robot move.

cards.back:
A machine that can do tasks by itself.
Bahasa Indonesia: robot
Example: The robot picked up the box and moved it.
cards.say: robot. A machine that can do tasks by itself. The robot picked up the box and moved it.

cards.back:
A flat computer that you control by touching the screen.
Bahasa Indonesia: tablet
Example: She reads her ebook on a tablet.
cards.say: tablet. A flat computer that you control by touching the screen. She reads her ebook on a tablet.

cards.back:
A website that helps you find information.
Bahasa Indonesia: mesin pencari
Example: Type your question into the search engine.
cards.say: search engine. A website that helps you find information. Type your question into the search engine.

cards.back:
Connected to the internet.
Bahasa Indonesia: daring
Example: We had an online lesson at home.
cards.say: online. Connected to the internet. We had an online lesson at home.

cards.back:
To fill a battery with electricity.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengisi daya
Example: I must charge my tablet tonight.
cards.say: charge. To fill a battery with electricity. I must charge my tablet tonight.

cards.back:
A call where you can see and hear each other.
Bahasa Indonesia: panggilan video
Example: We had a video call with Grandma.
cards.say: video call. A call where you can see and hear each other. We had a video call with Grandma.

cards.back:
A machine that puts words or pictures on paper.
Bahasa Indonesia: printer
Example: The printer ran out of paper.
cards.say: printer. A machine that puts words or pictures on paper. The printer ran out of paper.

cards.back:
To remove something from a computer.
Bahasa Indonesia: menghapus
Example: Please delete the old photos to save space.
cards.say: delete. To remove something from a computer. Please delete the old photos to save space.

cards.back:
To keep a file on a computer so you do not lose it.
Bahasa Indonesia: menyimpan
Example: Save your work before you close the page.
cards.say: save. To keep a file on a computer so you do not lose it. Save your work before you close the page.

cards.back:
To press a mouse button to choose something on the screen.
Bahasa Indonesia: mengklik
Example: Click the picture to make it bigger.
cards.say: click. To press a mouse button to choose something on the screen. Click the picture to make it bigger.

cards.back:
A harmful program that can damage a computer.
Bahasa Indonesia: virus
Example: A computer virus can delete your files.
cards.say: virus. A harmful program that can damage a computer. A computer virus can delete your files.
